.

The applicants in both the applications are seeking quashment of the First
Information Reports.
2.  We have heard both the sides and perused the papers.

3. The father of wife has lodged the FIR bearing No. 0111 of 2021 on the basis of which the offences punishable under Sections 326, 498A, 504, 427 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code has been registered with the Mukundwadi Police Station on 07 th April, 2021.
Crime No. 0112/2021 is registered with the same police sation for the offence punishable under Sections 452, 324, 504, 506 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, by husband.
It is apparent that the genesis for both these consecutive FIRs is matrimonial discord.
It has been specifically stated in the affidavit-in-reply on behalf of respondent no. 2 in both the applications that the couple has resumed cohabitation.
Allowing the investigation to be continued and making the parties face the trial could play a spoilsport when the couple has been cohabiting together.
It cannot be said that the proposed settlement in both these matters is against any public policy or has been arrived at with some ulterior motive.

Shaikh Hakeem S/O Sk. Shakur And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10279735/
2 5.
In view of the compromise arrived at between the parties as stated in affidavit-in-reply filed on behalf of respondent no. 2 in the respective applications, the crimes are quashed and set aside.
6. Both the applications are allowed.

7. The First Information Report No. 0111 of 2021 dated 07.04.2021 registerd with the Mukundwadi Police Station as against the Shaikh Hakeem Sk. Shakur, Shaikh Mohsin Shaikh Hakeem and Shaikh Mateen Shaikh Hakeem for the offences punishable under Sections 326, 498A, 504, 427 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and First Information Report No. 0112 of 2021 dated 07.04.2021 registerd with the 4 16APPLN1625-2022&17.odt Mukundwadi Police Station against Syed Khaja Hussain Sk.
Jahagirdar, Nazir Khaja Hussain Sk. Jahagirdar, Shaikh Ayub Mansoor and Shaikh Shakil Mansoor for the offences punishable under Sections 452, 324, 504, 506 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, are quashed and set aside.

[ M. M. SATHAYE ] [ MANGESH S. PATIL ]
 JUDGE JUDGE SGP Shaikh Hakeem S/O Sk. Shakur And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10279735/
